rows.en: Minami, are you all right? We've come to rescue you! Please open this entrance!
We came to rescue you at Daisaku's request!

It's not that I don't believe you, but let me make sure…

The password… "What's Napoleon's trump card?"
"15 of Diamonds" "Ace of Hearts" "15 of Clovers" "Ace of Diamonds"
I see… So that's your answer?
Waaaaagh…
Damn you, BF… Trying to fool me is useless! How do you like that!

Oh, thank goodness!

I was worried whether I'd passed the password on to all of you properly!

That password is used in common by every branch of the Unicorn Agency.
I nearly hurt you all badly! So… what about the code-breaking machine?
We recovered it safely! And this time we beat the mollusk kaiju Ikagerasu, too. Mission complete.
All right… Let's contact the branch right away.
This is U7, this is U7… Branch, come in.
Contacting us over the comm line… So it seems you've recovered the code-breaking machine safely?
Yes, and U3 is safe too!
Hey, [HERO2]… What is an omamori?

An omamori!?

Well… it's something you carry to protect yourself, how do I put it? It's hard to explain to you…
Is it some kind of defensive shield?
Hmm, well, depending on how the person carrying it feels, you could say that… But what's this about? [HERO4]?
Mitsuko gave Jiro a defensive shield from Izumo Grand Shrine…

I see, so that's it…

But… what is Mitsuko thinking? Izumo Grand Shrine is the god of matchmaking, you know?
Hey, [HERO2]… I want a charm too.
Huh? You want a charm? What's gotten into you all of a sudden…
'Cause Jiro got one from Mitsuko. A charm…
I see… Then I'll buy you one at Tomioka Hachimangu Shrine, near Amigo.
No, no, nooo! It's meaningless unless it's a charm from Izumo Grand Shrine!
Where even is Izumo Grand Shrine! Who's brand-conscious about charms? Come on, we're going home, [HERO4]…
[HERO2], you idiot!
Curse you, Gavan… Just you wait. I'll show you how terrifying Makuu can be.
Dr. Komyoji had finally fallen into DARK's hands. Professor Gill launched a secret plan to defeat his archenemy Kikaider!
Into the body of the strongest android, he transplanted none other than Dr. Komyoji's brain. Kikaider cannot attack Hakaider! DARK's fierce assault was about to begin!
Eeek…
Recover the code-breaking machine and defeat all of BF and Makuu!
Seize the laboratory and recover the code-breaking machine! Defeat all of BF, Makuu and the DARK Destruction Squad!
Daisaku Kusama, Chief Kitakura or Jiro is defeated
Daisaku Kusama or Chief Kitakura is defeated
<c3>Ichiro</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Ichiro</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
Sis… Do you really have to open up Jiro's body?

You see, Jiro… is still missing one more circuit.

Once I install it, Jiro will be complete. With Father missing, I'm the only one who can do it…
I don't want to… I don't want to see. Jiro's just like a human, but inside his body, he's machinery…

I feel the same…

But it's my duty! …!?

Jiro?
I'm fine as I am. Please don't do anything unnecessary!
Don't stop me! Father asked me to…

Dr. Komyoji's Conscience Circuit may be incomplete. But…

I make up for that incompleteness by controlling it with my own will! Mitsuko, I'm fine the way I am!

Jiro, I want you to be complete. Because your Conscience Circuit is incomplete, you waste energy.

Please! Let me do it, and become a complete android!
Even if you're the one asking, Mitsuko, that's the one thing I can't agree to!
Why not? I'm sure Father wants you to be complete too.
Dr. Komyoji too? Why?

Do you know… why he named you Jiro?

The truth is, my brother and I had an older brother. His name was Taro.

I see… So that's why my name is Jiro?

I'd assumed it was because the doctor built me as the younger brother of Ichiro, who remains faintly in my memory computer…
Father built you hoping you would carry on the strong sense of justice and love of peace of our late brother Taro.
Taro is dead?
He was the chief of the Environmental Guard Corps… A forest fire broke out, and he died protecting a village.
And the one who started that forest fire was DARK… Jiro, please! Let me install the last part of the Conscience Circuit!

I… I've always faced you as a man, as if I were human.

Inside this body of mine, there's a power engine instead of a heart, and a computer for a brain. I know that, but… I don't want you to see any more of it!
Jiro…
Hmm, we sure live in amazing times…
What's the matter, Mr. Tachibana?

Oh, [HERO4]. This paper's top story!

"World Robot Expo Opens"… Science has finally come this far, huh.
Robotics has made dramatic progress, thanks in part to Giant Robo's achievements.
Apparently the highlight of the exhibits is a robot built by Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai, Japan's pride in robotics.
That's Hiryu, the one in this photo, isn't it?
It's an amazing robot, all right… But we're probably not the only ones who think so.
What do you mean, Hayato…?

In other words…

Shocker and the other organizations probably want this robot too. That's what he means, Oyassan.
Sure enough, if a super robot like this fell into enemy hands, it'd be a disaster. What's the security like at the site?
According to TDF information… a group called the SSI is handling security.

The SSI? I've heard they're secret investigators, half government and half private…

I wonder if they'll be enough on their own.
What's up, Mr. Tachibana?

Oh, [HERO4]. This paper's top story!

"World Robot Expo Opens"… Science has finally come this far, huh.
Robotics has really leapt forward since Daisaku got Giant Robo, huh.
That's Hiryu, the one in this photo, right? I've been following it.
Oh? You're asking for our DARK's cooperation, Dr. Deviler?

I'm asking as a friend who once studied mechanical engineering alongside you.

If my giant robots team up with your Destruction Squad, we'll be invincible.

Our DARK Destruction Squad is plenty strong without borrowing the power of your Iron Mask Party…

But the completion of DARK's pride, the Giant Devil, is still far off… With the cooperation of your robot empire, its completion would be within reach, is that it?

Very well… I'll join hands with your robot empire, the Iron Mask Party. But don't try any clumsy tricks…

DARK Destruction Squad! Grey Rhinoking, Kaimen Green! Attack the World Robot Expo site! Kidnap the scientists from every country!
Brother!
Hey, Ken! Are you heading to the venue too?
It's finally tomorrow, isn't it, Brother…
Yeah… Are you doing well too?
As you can see! By the way, Brother…
